GLS.feature.resource-bars.title: Resource Bars
GLS.feature.resource-bars.hint: Replaces Foundry's token bars with shaded, animated bars that respond to damage and healing. System-agnostic, with temp-HP and shield layers under PF2e.
GLRB.Settings.EnabledBars.Name: Bars to replace
GLRB.Settings.EnabledBars.Hint: Whether the secondary bar (bar2) is drawn alongside the primary one. Whatever each token's bars are bound to is respected either way.
GLRB.Settings.Segments.Name: Divisions
GLRB.Settings.Segments.Hint: How many plates the primary bar is assembled from. Divisions let players read health by position as well as by colour, which matters for colour-blind viewers. 0 draws one continuous fill.
GLRB.Settings.LowThreshold.Name: Low-health threshold (%)
GLRB.Settings.LowThreshold.Hint: Below this fraction the bar's frame pulses, its glow turns red, and a diagonal hatch fades into the fill.
GLRB.Settings.FloatingDeltas.Name: Floating damage numbers
GLRB.Settings.FloatingDeltas.Hint: Show the amount lost or gained as a number that rises off the bar. Off by default; dedicated modules cover this ground and some tables find it noisy.
GLRB.Settings.Pf2eLayers.Name: PF2e temp HP and shields
GLRB.Settings.Pf2eLayers.Hint: Draw temporary hit points as a shield plate over the bar, and a raised shield as its own rail beneath it. Ignored outside Pathfinder 2e.
GLRB.Settings.Bloom.Name: Bloom
GLRB.Settings.Bloom.Hint: Let highlights and impacts cast light past the edge of the bar. Costs one extra render pass over all bars together. Turn it off if the canvas struggles.
GLRB.Settings.MotionTier.Name: Motion
GLRB.Settings.MotionTier.Hint: How much the bars animate on your screen. This is your choice alone and does not affect anyone else at the table.
GLRB.Settings.Ramp.Name: Colour ramp
GLRB.Settings.Ramp.Hint: The default ramp runs green to red. The colour-blind-safe ramp runs blue to orange instead, avoiding the red/green axis entirely.
GLRB.Settings.Numbers.Name: Show values
GLRB.Settings.Numbers.Hint: When the numeric readout is drawn. This can never show more than the token's own Display Bars setting already permits — if the GM has hidden a token's bars from you, no number appears.
GLRB.Settings.OffsetX.Name: Bar offset — horizontal
GLRB.Settings.OffsetX.Hint: Shifts every bar sideways, in grid squares (0.1 is a tenth of a square). Grid squares rather than pixels so the placement holds on scenes with different grid sizes. A token can override this in its own configuration.
GLRB.Settings.OffsetY.Name: Bar offset — vertical
GLRB.Settings.OffsetY.Hint: Shifts every bar up or down, in grid squares. Negative moves the stack up onto the token, positive moves it further below. A token can override this in its own configuration.
GLRB.TokenConfig.OffsetX.Name: Bar offset — horizontal
GLRB.TokenConfig.OffsetX.Hint: Grid squares. Leave blank to follow the world default shown in the field.
GLRB.TokenConfig.OffsetY.Name: Bar offset — vertical
GLRB.TokenConfig.OffsetY.Hint: Grid squares; negative moves the bars up onto the token. Leave blank to follow the world default shown in the field.
